# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct (summary)

This project follows the Contributor Covenant to foster a welcoming and
harassment-free community. We expect all contributors to:

- Be respectful and considerate in all communications.
- Use welcoming and inclusive language.
- Gracefully accept constructive criticism.
- Focus on what is best for the project.

Unacceptable behavior, including harassment, discrimination, or abusive
language, will not be tolerated. Report unacceptable behavior to the project
maintainers through GitHub.

For the full text of the Contributor Covenant, see:
[Contributor Covenant 2.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/0/code_of_conduct/).
